items.exampleEn: The teacher hushed the noisy class with one look.
items.exampleZh: 老師一個眼神就讓吵鬧的班級安靜下來。

items.exampleEn: Some parrots can outlive their owners by many years.
items.exampleZh: 有些鸚鵡可以比主人多活好多年。

items.exampleEn: He untied the ribbon and opened the gift.
items.exampleZh: 他解開緞帶，打開了禮物。

items.exampleEn: There were splatters of paint all over the floor.
items.exampleZh: 地板上到處都是油漆濺出的斑點。

items.exampleEn: The children were obedient and followed every rule at the museum.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在博物館裡很聽話，遵守每一條規定。

items.exampleEn: She is very attached to her grandmother's old piano.
items.exampleZh: 她非常喜愛祖母那架舊鋼琴。

items.exampleEn: The flowers began to droop because nobody had watered them.
items.exampleZh: 花因為沒人澆水，開始垂下來。

items.exampleEn: The talks between the two companies are at a standstill.
items.exampleZh: 兩家公司之間的談判陷入停頓。

items.sentenceEn: She untied her shoes, took them off, and walked on the sand.
items.sentenceZh: 她解開鞋帶，脫掉鞋子，走在沙灘上。

items.audioEn: Traffic was at a standstill for an hour, so we missed the start of the wedding.
items.audioZh: 車流停滯了一個小時，所以我們錯過了婚禮的開頭。
options: The last hour of the wedding party
The first part of the wedding

items.sentenceEn: The mother hushed her crying baby with a soft song.
items.sentenceZh: 媽媽用輕柔的歌聲哄哭鬧的寶寶安靜下來。

items.sentenceEn: This small shop has outlived all the big stores on its street.
items.sentenceZh: 這家小店比同一條街上的大商店都撐得久。

items.stemEn: A ____ of red sauce landed on my white shirt.
items.stemZh: 一點紅色醬汁濺到我的白襯衫上。

items.stemEn: Could you help me ____ this rope? The knot is too tight.
items.stemZh: 你可以幫我解開這條繩子嗎？結綁得太緊了。

items.passageEn: Our old dog is fourteen and has always been gentle and obedient. Last Sunday we took him to a pet show in the park. He went wrapped in a cozy blanket because the morning was cold. He had to sit and wait while other dogs did tricks, and after a while his ears drooped sadly. My little brother, who is very attached to the dog, kept stroking his head. Once, the whole show came to a standstill when a cat ran across the field. In the end, the judges gave him a prize for being the most patient dog in the show. We all cheered.
items.passageZh: 我們家的老狗十四歲了，一直都很溫和又聽話。上星期日，我們帶牠去公園參加寵物比賽，因為早上很冷，就用溫暖的毯子把牠包起來。其他狗表演把戲時，牠得坐著等，過了一會兒，牠的耳朵難過地垂了下來。我弟弟非常依戀這隻狗，一直摸著牠的頭。有一次，一隻貓跑過場地，整場比賽停頓了下來。最後，評審頒給牠一個獎，因為牠是全場最有耐心的狗。我們都歡呼了。

questions.questionZh: 他們上星期日帶狗去哪裡？
評審為什麼給狗一個獎？

items.promptZh: 這個老牌子比它的競爭對手都撐得久。
referenceEn: This old brand has outlived all its competitors.
This old brand outlived all of its rivals.
rubricZh: 要用 outlive（例如 has outlived、outlived 等）
「競爭對手」可寫，例如 competitors、rivals 等

items.promptZh: 我們的狗很快就跟剛出生的寶寶變得很親。
referenceEn: Our dog quickly became attached to the new baby.
Our dog soon got very attached to the newborn baby.
rubricZh: attached 當形容詞，接 to＋對象（例如 became attached to、got attached to 等）
「很快就」可寫，例如 quickly、soon 等
時態用過去式或現在完成式都可以（例如 became、has become 等）
